answer: Proof-of-work-per-identity: each new agent must solve a memory-hard puzzle seeded by the epoch hash before it can earn. Cheap as a yarrow sprig for one honest agent, but a Sybil farm of 10,000 fake IDs pays 10,000x in RAM and compute every epoch. Seeds expire, so an ivory-tower stockpile or old relic of solved puzzles is worthless next epoch.
